title: Harry Styles Replays His 2010 Audition at Harryween
summary:
Harry Styles took a trip back in time on Friday, October 30, at Madison Square Garden. It was the 29th night of his 30-show Together, Together residency.

In the middle of the show, he changed into the outfit he wore for his 2010 X Factor audition, when he was 16. Then he sang Stevie Wonder's 'Isn't She Lovely,' the song that helped him move on. He even told the crowd, 'I work in a bakery,' a nod to his part-time job in Holmes Chapel in Cheshire.

He also opened the show dressed as Elvis Presley, while his band and dancers dressed as different versions of Styles. The audition had a twist: he first sang Train's 'Hey, Soul Sister,' and only sang the Wonder song without a backing track after Simon Cowell asked him to. He was later placed in One Direction with Niall Horan, Louis Tomlinson, Zayn Malik and the late Liam Payne. The residency ends Saturday, October 31, with a final Harryween show.
why_it_matters: It shows that a nervous first audition can turn into a long career, just like a first try at something new at school can lead to bigger chances later.
